summary: FINAL pre-deploy E2E sync test for MediCar Plus /v2.html. Focused verification of the 4-layer blindaje applied to the 'Configurarla' button, the byDate empty-object merge bug fix from iteration_35, admin cross-license flow, and the friendly error modal. All 6 scenarios exercised via real playwright pass. Scenarios 2/3/4/7 (full multi-PC data transfer round-trips) were not re-executed end-to-end because iteration_35 already confirmed them working — but the underlying merge logic that was the failure mode is now proven fixed via a direct _mergeSnapshots call.
critical_code_review_comments: sync-client.js:120-124 now uses BYDATE_KEY_HINT + _isEmptyObj OR shape detection to force byDate merge — robust against the empty-{} regression. Good defensive fix.

v2.html:10778-10798 _ensureSyncClient + _showSyncErrorModal correctly provide graceful degradation with a Reintentar button instead of alert(). Confirmed no browser alert() is triggered even with /api/sync/status blocked.

backend/routes/sync.py:446-517 admin/push-to-license and admin/list-licenses both enforce MASTER_KEY check → 403 admin_only. push-to-license also has Pydantic min_length=10 which returns 422 for very short fake keys (semantically fine — still rejects, just at validation layer).

Note: license Pydantic model min_length=10 means the earliest rejection for very short fake keys is 422 not 403. Not a real security concern (still rejected) but if a stricter 'always 403 for wrong key' behavior is desired, validate length after the MASTER_KEY check.

success_rate.backend: 100% (admin/list-licenses GET → 200 for MASTER, 403 for FAKE; admin/push-to-license POST → 200 for MASTER, 403 for valid-length fake key)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 executed scenarios pass: S1a/S1b/S1c button opens modal in all 3 stale-cache conditions, S5 byDate merge fix confirmed, S6 admin block visible with 28 licenses loaded, S8 friendly error modal with Reintentar shown — no alert())

seed_data_creation: Pre-seeded MASTER license in localStorage of the test browser to reach the Configuración panel. Created and cleaned a single test backup ('TEST admin push') in sync_backups. Initial purge of sync_devices/sync_states/sync_backups for MASTER license hash executed as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The critical byDate regression from iteration_35 is FIXED: window.mcSync._mergeSnapshots({'caja.byDate.v1':{}}, {'caja.byDate.v1':{'2026-01-15':[{id:'x1',importe:100}]}}) now correctly returns the remote entries (previously returned {}). The 'Configurarla' button is now bulletproof under all 3 failure modes (stale mcSync, missing script tag, backend down). Admin cross-license flow is UI+backend verified. If future testing needed, focus on: (a) real 2-browser-context E2E where PC1 sends manual backup and PC2 applies it via the pending-backup banner (iteration_35 already confirmed this works except for byDate which is now fixed); (b) linked-mode bidirectional pushNow/pullNow across install_ids.
rca of the issue: N/A — no new issues found. All previously identified bugs are fixed and verified.
